question: 专辑数量最多的前 10 位艺术家是谁？各有多少张专辑？
reference_sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(*) FROM artist a JOIN album al ON al.artistid = a.artistid GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, a.name LIMIT 10

question: 销量最高的前 10 首曲目是哪些？按购买数量统计。
reference_sql: SELECT t.name, SUM(il.quantity) FROM track t JOIN invoiceline il ON il.trackid = t.trackid GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY SUM(il.quantity) DESC, t.name LIMIT 10

question: 消费总金额最高的前 5 位客户是谁？给出姓氏、名字和总消费。
reference_sql: SELECT c.lastname, c.firstname, SUM(i.total) FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customerid = c.customerid GROUP BY c.customerid, c.lastname, c.firstname ORDER BY SUM(i.total) DESC, c.lastname, c.firstname LIMIT 5

question: 每个国家有多少位客户、总消费额是多少？按国家名称排序。
reference_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customerid), SUM(i.total) FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customerid = c.customerid GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country

question: 摇滚曲风里销量第一的曲目是哪一首？
reference_sql: SELECT t.name FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genreid = t.genreid JOIN invoiceline il ON il.trackid = t.trackid WHERE g.name = 'Rock' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY SUM(il.quantity) DESC, t.name LIMIT 1

question: 销售支持员工 Jane Peacock 负责哪些客户？列出客户姓名，按姓氏排序。
reference_sql: SELECT c.firstname, c.lastname FROM customer c JOIN employee e ON e.employeeid = c.supportrepid WHERE e.firstname = 'Jane' AND e.lastname = 'Peacock' ORDER BY c.lastname, c.firstname

question: Heavy Metal Classic 这个歌单里有哪些曲目？列出曲目名和所属专辑名。
reference_sql: SELECT t.name, al.title FROM playlist p JOIN playlisttrack pt ON pt.playlistid = p.playlistid JOIN track t ON t.trackid = pt.trackid JOIN album al ON al.albumid = t.albumid WHERE p.name = 'Heavy Metal Classic' ORDER BY t.name, al.title

question: 从未被购买过的曲目有多少首？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoiceline il WHERE il.trackid = t.trackid)

question: 哪些曲风的平均曲目单价超过 1 美元？列出曲风名和平均单价，按曲风名排序。
reference_sql: SELECT g.name, AVG(t.unitprice) FROM genre g JOIN track t ON t.genreid = g.genreid GROUP BY g.name HAVING AVG(t.unitprice) > 1 ORDER BY g.name

question: 包含曲风种类最多的前 5 张专辑是哪些？各包含几种曲风？
reference_sql: SELECT al.title, COUNT(DISTINCT t.genreid) FROM album al JOIN track t ON t.albumid = al.albumid GROUP BY al.albumid, al.title ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT t.genreid) DESC, al.title LIMIT 5

question: 公司里每位有直属上级的员工，他们的上级分别是谁？按员工姓氏排序。
reference_sql: SELECT e.firstname, e.lastname, m.firstname, m.lastname FROM employee e JOIN employee m ON m.employeeid = e.reportsto ORDER BY e.lastname, e.firstname

question: 巴西客户的所有发票总金额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(i.total) FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON c.customerid = i.customerid WHERE c.country = 'Brazil'

question: 每种媒体格式分别被购买了多少件？按格式名称排序。
reference_sql: SELECT m.name, SUM(il.quantity) FROM mediatype m JOIN track t ON t.mediatypeid = m.mediatypeid JOIN invoiceline il ON il.trackid = t.trackid GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY m.name

question: AC/DC 这个艺术家有哪些专辑？按专辑名排序。
reference_sql: SELECT al.title FROM artist a JOIN album al ON al.artistid = a.artistid WHERE a.name = 'AC/DC' ORDER BY al.title

question: 2024 年每个国家的总销售额是多少？按国家名称排序。
reference_sql: SELECT c.country, SUM(i.total) FROM invoice i JOIN customer c ON c.customerid = i.customerid WHERE i.invoicedate >= '2024-01-01' AND i.invoicedate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country

question: 哪些客户既购买过摇滚曲风的曲目，又购买过爵士曲风的曲目？按姓氏排序。
reference_sql: SELECT c.firstname, c.lastname FROM customer c WHERE c.customerid IN (SELECT i.customerid FROM invoice i JOIN invoiceline il ON il.invoiceid = i.invoiceid JOIN track t ON t.trackid = il.trackid JOIN genre g ON g.genreid = t.genreid WHERE g.name = 'Rock') AND c.customerid IN (SELECT i.customerid FROM invoice i JOIN invoiceline il ON il.invoiceid = i.invoiceid JOIN track t ON t.trackid = il.trackid JOIN genre g ON g.genreid = t.genreid WHERE g.name = 'Jazz') ORDER BY c.lastname, c.firstname

question: 每位销售支持员工名下客户的总消费是多少？按业绩从高到低排序。
reference_sql: SELECT e.firstname, e.lastname, SUM(i.total) FROM employee e JOIN customer c ON c.supportrepid = e.employeeid JOIN invoice i ON i.customerid = c.customerid GROUP BY e.employeeid, e.firstname, e.lastname ORDER BY SUM(i.total) DESC, e.lastname

question: 销量高于全体曲目平均销量的前 20 首曲目是哪些？列出曲目名和销量，按销量从高到低排序。
reference_sql: SELECT t.name, SUM(il.quantity) FROM track t JOIN invoiceline il ON il.trackid = t.trackid GROUP BY t.name HAVING SUM(il.quantity) > (SELECT AVG(q) FROM (SELECT SUM(quantity) AS q FROM invoiceline GROUP BY trackid) x) ORDER BY SUM(il.quantity) DESC, t.name LIMIT 20

question: 名字包含 Greatest Hits 的专辑各有多少首曲目？按专辑名排序。
reference_sql: SELECT al.title, COUNT(t.trackid) FROM album al JOIN track t ON t.albumid = al.albumid WHERE al.title ILIKE '%Greatest Hits%' GROUP BY al.albumid, al.title ORDER BY al.title

question: 消费总金额最高的那位客户，最常购买（按数量）的曲风是什么？
reference_sql: SELECT g.name, SUM(il.quantity) FROM customer c JOIN invoice i ON i.customerid = c.customerid JOIN invoiceline il ON il.invoiceid = i.invoiceid JOIN track t ON t.trackid = il.trackid JOIN genre g ON g.genreid = t.genreid WHERE c.customerid = (SELECT i2.customerid FROM invoice i2 GROUP BY i2.customerid ORDER BY SUM(i2.total) DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY SUM(il.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 每个曲风各有多少首曲目？输出曲风名称和数量，按数量从多到少排序。
reference_sql: SELECT g.name, COUNT(*) FROM track t JOIN genre g ON g.genreid = t.genreid GROUP BY g.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, g.name
